quotes.text: The rapid development of AI (artificial intelligence) has created growing concerns about how this technology will affect our society in the future. With this, Congress is constantly being challenged with adapting to the ever-changing global technological landscape. While legislators must address the numerous concerns and place common-sense regulations on AI technologies, it is also our duty to enact legislation that encourages innovation and ensures that the United States remains a global technology leader.
